blockers.summary: Firebase App Check debug-token exchange returns 403 for BOTH registered tokens, so the simulator cannot reach Firestore (Code=7). Blocks live-backend simulator testing; does NOT block UI work — the app's own -SkyGridUIAudit harness renders every screen with synthetic data.
blockers.correctionToPriorSession: Earlier note concluded 'Google-side outage' because an unregistered random UUID also returned 403. That reasoning is inverted: an unregistered token SHOULD 403. Both registered tokens (c3bf4641..., e4e3ea9d...) were confirmed present in the project's debugTokens list yet still fail exchange, so the cause is still open — but it is NOT proven to be an outage.
